recipes.title: Strip-It-Rich Cake
steps: Prepare cake mix as directed, baking in a 13x9 in. pan.
Remove from oven. At once, poke holes down through the cake to the pan with the round handle of a wooden spoon, 1 in. apart.
Only after poking holes, combine pudding mix with sugar in a large bowl. Gradually stir in milk. Beat 1 min.
Quickly, before the pudding thickens, pour half of the thin pudding evenly over the warm cake and into the holes to make the stripes.
Let the remaining pudding thicken slightly, then spoon it over the top, swirling to "frost" the cake.
Chill at least 1 hour. Store cake in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Light 'n Fruity Pie
ingredients: Optional: 1 can (8¾ oz) apricots, peaches, or fruit cocktail, drained and diced
Optional: 1 can (8¼ oz) crushed pineapple, drained
steps: Dissolve gelatin completely in boiling water, stirring about 3 min.
Add ice cubes and stir until gelatin is thickened, about 2 to 3 min. Remove any unmelted ice.
Blend in Cool Whip, then whip until smooth.
Fold in fruit. Chill if necessary until the mixture will mound.
Spoon into crust. Chill 2 hours. Garnish if desired.

recipes.title: Skillet Tuna Patties
steps: Mix thoroughly ½ cup soup, tuna, cornmeal, egg, and onion. Shape into 4 patties.
In a skillet, brown patties in butter; remove.
Stir remaining soup and milk into the drippings and add patties back. Heat, stirring occasionally.
Garnish with chopped parsley.

recipes.title: Romona's Layered Dessert
steps: Mix flour, butter, and walnuts. Press into pan and bake at 350° for 12 min. Let cool.
Mix cream cheese, powdered sugar, and half of the Cool Whip. Spread over the cooled crust; cool.
Mix the pudding and 3 c milk. Spread over the cream cheese layer; cool again.
Spread the rest of the Cool Whip over the top.

recipes.title: Santa's Whiskers
ingredients: ¾ cup finely chopped red or green candied cherries
steps: Cream together butter and sugar; blend in milk and vanilla or rum flavoring.
Stir in flour, candied cherries, and pecans.
Form dough into two 8-inch rolls. Roll in flaked coconut to coat the outside.
Wrap in waxed paper or plastic wrap; chill thoroughly.
Cut into ¼-inch slices. Place on an ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° till edges are golden, about 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Mile High Raspberry Pie
recipes.note: Graham cracker pie shell can be used instead.
ingredients: 1 (10 oz) package raspberries, or 1½ c fresh
steps: Thaw raspberries. Reserve a few for garnish.
In a bowl combine raspberries, sugar, egg whites, lemon juice, and salt. Beat 15 min or till stiff.
Fold in whipped cream and almond extract.
Mound in the baked pastry shell. Freeze until firm.
Garnish with the reserved berries and a sprig of mint.

recipes.title: Sugar Ginger Cookies
steps: Mix in order, sifting the dry ingredients together.
Form balls and roll in sugar. Do not press down.
Chill 2 hrs or overnight.
Bake at 375° for 10 min.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
ingredients: ¾ c mashed ripe bananas (1–2 med)
¼ c buttermilk or sour milk
steps: Beat sugar and butter on medium until well blended.
Add bananas, buttermilk, egg, and vanilla; beat till well blended.
Stir in flour, soda, and salt until moistened.
Pour into a greased loaf pan. Bake at 350°F for 50–60 min.
Cool 10 min, then remove from pan to a wire rack.

recipes.title: McKenzie River Hazelnut Pie
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Beat eggs until blended but not frothy. Add, in order, sugar, salt, corn syrup, melted butter, and vanilla, mixing to blend.
Stir in hazelnuts. Divide filling between the two pie shells and place in oven.
Reduce oven heat to 325° and bake 50–60 minutes.

recipes.title: Finnish Ribbon Cakes
ingredients: ½ cup powdered sugar mixed with 1 Tbs water
steps: Beat butter and sugar till creamy. Add egg yolk and vanilla; beat.
Add lemon peel; mix. Gradually add flour and salt; mix thoroughly.
Shape into ropes ¾" thick and as long as your baking sheet. Press a long groove down the center.
Bake at 375° for 7 min.
Spoon jam into the grooves. Bake 5 min more.
Drizzle with powdered sugar icing, then cut at a 45° angle into 1" lengths.

recipes.title: 7 Up Biscuits
steps: Mix Bisquick, sour cream, and 7 Up. Dough will be very soft — don't worry.
Knead and fold the dough until coated with baking mix. Pat out and cut biscuits with a round cutter.
Melt butter in the bottom of a cookie sheet pan or 9x13 casserole dish.
Place biscuits on the melted butter and bake 12–15 min at 425°, until brown.

recipes.title: Beef Stew
steps: Coat meat with flour and brown in oil.
Add onion, garlic, and thyme.
Stir in vegetable juice, bouillon, and hot pepper sauce.
Add water, potatoes, celery, and carrots. Cook 1¼ hrs.
Skim off fat.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
steps: Mix well.
Pour into greased pans: 3 large or 5–6 mini.
Bake at 350° for 1 hr.

recipes.title: Chicken Pie
ingredients: 1 (10¾ oz) can cream of celery soup
steps: Cut strips into two pieces. Sauté chicken in hot oil for 5–6 min.
Transfer to a greased 9" deep-dish pie plate. Drizzle melted margarine over chicken.
Combine flour and milk, beating until smooth. Fold in cheese. Pour over chicken.
In a small saucepan combine soup and broth; bring to a boil. Pour over chicken.
Bake at 425° for 25 min. Cut into wedges.

recipes.title: Italian Macaroni Pie
steps: Heat oven to 350°F. Grease a 10" pie pan or 9" square pan. Prepare macaroni according to package; drain.
In a large skillet, brown ground beef with celery; drain. Stir in spaghetti sauce and mushrooms. Simmer 15 min.
In a large bowl combine macaroni, eggs, ⅓ c Parmesan, and garlic salt; toss lightly.
Press macaroni mixture evenly into the bottom and up the sides of the pan, forming a crust.
Pour meat mixture over macaroni; cover with foil. Bake 25–30 min.
Remove foil; let stand 5 min before cutting. Sprinkle with Parmesan.

recipes.title: Spell-Binders
ingredients: 1 cup plus 2 Tbs finely crushed corn flakes
steps: Oven 300°. In large mixing bowl combine all ingredients except rolled oats, coconut, peanuts, and corn flakes. Blend well with mixer.
Stir in rolled oats, coconut, peanuts, and 1 cup corn flake crumbs. Drop by rounded teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheets.
Flatten slightly with bottom of glass dipped in remaining 2 Tbs corn flakes. Bake 13 to 15 min. Drizzle with glaze.

recipes.title: Applesauce Bars
steps: Sift dry ingredients together. Cream sugar, shortening, and baking soda. Add applesauce. Mix well and then add flour mixture.
Then add raisins and coconut mixed with 1 Tbsp flour. Bake at 400° for 15–20 min. Put on white hot topping.

recipes.title: Apple Slices
ingredients: Apple slices — enough to cover a large cookie sheet
steps: Mix together flour, shortening, and salt. Add egg yolks, lemon juice, and water; mix together. Roll ½ of dough into a bottom crust to fit a large cookie sheet.
Cover crust with a single layer of apple slices. Sprinkle with sugar, nutmeg, cinnamon, and salt. Cover with remaining crust. Bake 30–35 min.
While warm, drizzle with powdered sugar glaze.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Cake
steps: Sift flour, measure, and re-sift 3 times with soda, salt, and cinnamon. Combine shortening and cream thoroughly. Gradually blend in the sugar, then add eggs.
Beat vigorously until mixture is smooth and fluffy.
Add flour mixture and buttermilk alternately in 3 or 4 portions, beginning and ending with flour, beating well after each addition.
Turn batter into two 8-inch layer cake pans, buttered on all sides and lined with wax paper on the bottom.
Bake in a moderate oven at 350° for about 25 minutes or until springy when lightly pressed with fingertips. Turn out on cake rack and cool.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar or frost.

recipes.title: Chocolate Lush
steps: Mix dry ingredients. Combine oil, milk, and vanilla; mix into dry ingredients. Spread in pan. Pour topping mixture over batter in pan. Bake 45 min at 350°.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Pie with Chocolate Ganache
cardImages: uploads/Peanut Butter Pie with Chocolate Ganache - Front.png
uploads/Peanut Butter Pie with Chocolate Ganache - Back.png
ingredients: 1 baked pie crust or 1 graham cracker crust
steps: Whip butter, sugar, cream cheese, vanilla, and peanut butter together. In a separate bowl, whip 2–3 cups of whipping cream. Fold into whipped mixture. Put into the crust.
Firm up overnight.
Ganache: Bring 1 cup whipping cream to almost boil. Pour over chocolate chips. Cover with plastic wrap for 10 min. Whip together. Pour over peanut butter pie.

recipes.title: Almond Caramels
steps: Spread bottom and sides of 9x5x3-inch loaf pan with butter or margarine.
In 2-quart saucepan, combine granulated sugar, brown sugar, corn syrup, light cream, and the 4 Tbsp butter or margarine.
Cook and stir over medium heat till sugars dissolve. Continue cooking, stirring occasionally, to firm ball stage (248°). Remove from heat; stir in vanilla and almonds.
Turn into prepared pan; cool. Cut in squares; wrap each.

recipes.title: Ambrosia Eggnog Candy
steps: Butter sides of heavy 3-quart saucepan. In prepared pan combine sugar, eggnog, and corn syrup.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, till the mixture comes to boiling. Cook to soft ball stage (238°) without stirring.
Immediately remove from heat; cool to lukewarm (110°) without stirring. Add butter and vanilla.
Beat vigorously till very thick and candy just starts to lose its gloss, about 8 minutes. Quickly stir in cherries and coconut; pour into buttered 8x4x2-inch loaf pan.

recipes.title: Butterscotch-Peanut Fudge
steps: In saucepan combine butterscotch pieces, milk, and marshmallows. Stir over medium heat till marshmallows melt.
Remove from heat; beat in peanut butter, vanilla, and dash salt. Stir in nuts. Pour into buttered 9x9x2-inch pan. Chill. Cut in squares. Store in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Swirls
ingredients: ¼ cup shredded or flaked coconut
steps: Mix peanut butter, powdered sugar, coconut, and corn syrup in medium bowl. Stir in cereal. Shape mixture into 1⅛-inch balls. Flatten slightly.
Heat chocolate chips and water in saucepan over medium heat, stirring constantly, until melted. Cool. Dip tops of balls into chocolate.
Place on wax paper-lined cookie sheet. Refrigerate until firm, about 30 minutes. Store in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Christmas Jelly Candy
ingredients: 2 cups desired fruit juice, nectar, or drink (cranberry, grape, orange, or apricot)
steps: In 1½-quart saucepan combine gelatin and sugar. Add fruit juice; wait 5 minutes. Bring to boiling; reduce heat. Cook and stir till gelatin dissolves. Add lemon juice.
Pour into shallow pans or paper bake cups. Cool; chill till firm. If desired, loosen sides. Carefully turn out of pans using a wide spatula. Cut with cookie cutters.
Place on wire rack to dry. Cover pans or store cutouts in single layers between waxed paper in airtight containers up to 5 days. Makes about 24 pieces.
Cocktail Jelly Candy: Substitute bottled pina colada cocktail mix, daiquiri mix, or mai tai mix for the fruit juice.

recipes.title: Marshmallow Treats
ingredients: 1 pkg (10 oz, about 40) regular marshmallows OR 4 cups miniature marshmallows
steps: Melt margarine in large saucepan over low heat. Add marshmallows and stir until completely melted. Remove from heat.
Add Rice Krispies cereal. Stir until well coated.
Using buttered spatula or waxed paper, press mixture evenly into buttered 13x9x2-inch pan. Cut into squares when cool.
Use fresh marshmallows for best results. For thicker squares: Press warm mixture into buttered 9x9x2-inch pan.

recipes.title: Chicken Rolls
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves, pounded ¼" thick
1 can (10¾ oz) condensed cream of mushroom soup
steps: Heat oven to 400°F. Stir cut margarine into hot water in bowl until melted. Add stuffing crumbs, red pepper, and egg; stir until moistened.
Spoon stuffing evenly on chicken; roll tightly. Secure with toothpicks. Place in greased 9" square baking dish. Brush with melted margarine. Sprinkle with pepper.
Bake 30–35 min or until cooked through. Heat soup, water, and dill in saucepan. Serve over chicken.

recipes.title: Creamy Ham and Macaroni Bake
cardImages: uploads/Creamy Ham and Macaroni Bake - Front.png
uploads/Creamy Ham and Macaroni Bake - Back.png
ingredients: 1 (7 oz) pkg elbow macaroni (2 cups uncooked)
1 (10 oz) pkg asparagus cuts, thawed and drained
steps: Prepare macaroni according to pkg directions. Drain. Set aside. Heat oven 350°F. In large saucepan, melt margarine.
Stir in flour, salt, parsley flakes, dry mustard, and pepper. Blend in milk. Cook, stirring constantly, until thickened and bubbly. Add cheese; stir until melted.
Add cooked macaroni, ham, and mushrooms; mix well. Pour into buttered 2-qt pan. Sprinkle with bread crumbs. Bake 350°F for 30 min or until bubbly. Refrigerate leftovers.

recipes.title: Oregon Hazelnut Broccoli
ingredients: 2 (10 oz) pkgs frozen chopped broccoli (or 1½ lbs fresh)
steps: Cook broccoli until tender; drain thoroughly; put into a buttered 1½-quart casserole.
In a saucepan, melt ¼ cup butter; blend in flour and chicken stock base to make a smooth paste. Gradually add milk and cook, stirring frequently, until thick and smooth.
Mix into broccoli. Heat water and remaining ¼ cup butter until butter melts; pour over stuffing mix and hazelnuts and toss. Top broccoli with hazelnut mixture.
Bake uncovered at 400° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Famous Pumpkin Pie
ingredients: 3½ cups (29 oz can) LIBBY'S Solid Pack Pumpkin
steps: Combine sugar, salt, cinnamon, ginger, and cloves in medium bowl. Beat eggs lightly in large bowl. Stir in pumpkin and sugar-spice mixture.
Gradually stir in evaporated milk. Pour into pie shells.
Bake in preheated 425°F oven for 15 minutes. Reduce temperature to 350°F; bake for 40 to 50 minutes or until knife inserted near center comes out clean.
Cool on wire rack for 2 hours. Serve immediately or chill (do not freeze).

recipes.title: Holiday Ribbon Pie
ingredients: 1 cup finely chopped cookies, nuts, mini marshmallows, chocolate chips, or peanut butter chips (or ½ cup jam)
steps: Stir chocolate with water over low heat until melted. Cool. Beat cream cheese and sugar until smooth; add chocolate. Fold in 3½ cups whipped topping.
Spoon half the mixture into crust. Sprinkle with filling, pressing down gently. Spread remaining chocolate mixture carefully over filling. Chill 3 hrs.
Garnish with remaining whipped topping.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Pudding Cookies
ingredients: 1 cup firmly packed light brown sugar
1 package (6-serving size) JELL-O Instant Pudding — Butter Pecan, Chocolate, or Vanilla flavor
steps: Mix flour with baking soda. Combine butter, the sugars, pudding mix, and vanilla in a large mixer bowl; beat until smooth and creamy.
Gradually add flour mixture; then stir in chips and nuts. Drop by rounded measuring teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheets, about 2 inches apart.
Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Ice Cream Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 pint ice cream, cut into 6 slices
steps: In medium-size mixing bowl, stir together corn syrup and peanut butter. Add Rice Krispies cereal; stir until well coated.
Press mixture evenly in buttered 13x9x2-inch pan. Place in freezer or coldest part of refrigerator until firm.
Cut cereal mixture into twelve 3-inch squares. Sandwich each slice of ice cream between 2 squares. Freeze until firm.
Cut each large sandwich in half and wrap individually in foil. Store in freezer until needed.

recipes.title: Mini Kisses Thumbprint Cookies
ingredients: 1 cup (2 sticks) butter or margarine, softened
1 can (16 oz) Vanilla Frosting, divided into white, red, and green with food coloring
steps: Beat butter, sugar, egg yolks, milk, and vanilla till fluffy. Combine flour, cocoa, and salt; gradually add to butter mixture, beating until well blended.
Refrigerate dough about 2 hrs.
Heat oven 350°F. Lightly grease cookie sheet. Shape dough into 1⅛" balls. Roll in granulated sugar. Place on cookie sheet. Press thumb in center of each cookie.
Bake 10–12 min. Cool on rack 10 min.
Frosting: Divide into 3 bowls — white, red, and green. Frost cooled cookies. Place a Mini Kiss on each.

recipes.title: Oregon Hazelnut Raisin Cookies
ingredients: 1 tsp baking soda dissolved in 1 Tbsp water
steps: Cream shortening; add sugars and vanilla, egg, and water. Sift flour, salt, and soda together; add to creamed mixture. Stir in oatmeal, raisins, and hazelnuts.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet, about 2" apart. Bake at 375° for 10–12 minutes.
Toast hazelnuts for full flavor!

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Fruit Drops
ingredients: ¼ cup butter or margarine, softened
2 cups (12 oz) diced mixed candied fruits and peels
steps: In bowl beat together peanut butter and butter or margarine. Stir in eggs, honey, and milk till well blended. Stir in candied fruits and peels.
Stir together flour, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, and nutmeg; gradually blend into candied fruit mixture.
Drop dough by teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart on greased cookie sheet. Bake in a 350° oven for 10 to 12 minutes or till golden brown. Remove to wire rack; cool.
If desired, top each cookie with additional candied fruit.

recipes.title: Delicious Double Layer Chocolate Pie
cardImages: uploads/Delicious Double Layer Chocolate Pie - Front.png
uploads/Delicious Double Layer Chocolate Pie - Back.png
ingredients: 2 pkgs (3.4 oz each) Chocolate Instant Pudding
steps: Mix cream cheese, 1 Tbsp milk, and sugar in large bowl with wire whisk until smooth. Gently stir in 1½ cups of the whipped topping. Spread on bottom of crust.
Pour 1½ cups milk into bowl. Add pudding mixes. Beat with wire whisk 1 min. (Mixture will be thick.) Stir in remaining whipped topping. Spread over cream cheese layer.
Refrigerate 4 hrs or until set. Garnish with remaining whipped topping. Store leftover pie in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Sensational Double Layer Pumpkin Pie
cardImages: uploads/Sensational Double Layer Pumpkin Pie - Front.png
uploads/Sensational Double Layer Pumpkin Pie - Back.png
ingredients: 2 pkgs (4 oz each) instant vanilla pudding
steps: Mix cream cheese, 1 Tbsp milk, and sugar in large bowl with wire whisk until smooth. Gently stir in whipped topping. Spread on bottom of crust. Pour 1 cup milk into bowl.
Add pudding mixes. Beat with wire whisk 1 min. (Mixture will be thick.) Stir in pumpkin and spices with wire whisk until well mixed. Spread over cream cheese layer.
Refrigerate 4 hours or until set. Garnish with additional whipped topping if desired. Store leftover pie in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Cornmeal Pudding
recipes.note: Serve with ice cream or Cool Whip.
ingredients: ½ cup sugar or ¼ c honey
steps: Scald 3 cups of the milk and mix with the cornmeal. Add the other ingredients.
Bake at 250° for 6 hours.
After 20 min, mix in the other cup of milk.
Stir at least 6–7 times within the first 1½ hours, then cook the remaining hours.
Serve with ice cream or Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Breakfast or Anytime Drink
steps: Mix together in blender and serve.

recipes.title: Belgian Waffles
steps: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water in a mixing bowl. Add beaten egg yolks, vanilla, and mix thoroughly. Stir in flour, sugar, and salt until smooth.
Add melted butter and mix again. Beat egg whites until they form stiff peaks and fold into batter. Let batter set for ½ hr before baking.

recipes.title: Ham and Swiss Quiche
ingredients: 1 cup (4 oz) shredded Swiss cheese, divided
steps: Sprinkle ½ cup cheese, ham, and green onions into pie crust. Whisk together evaporated milk, eggs, flour, salt, and pepper in large bowl.
Pour mixture into pie shell; sprinkle with remaining cheese.
Bake at 350° for 45–50 min. Cool 10 min before serving.

recipes.title: Hash Brown Breakfast Casserole
steps: Cook sausages in a large skillet over medium-high heat, stirring until crumbled and no longer pink. Drain well.
Prepare hash browns according to package directions, using ½ tsp salt and pepper.
Stir together hash browns, sausage, and cheese. Pour into a lightly greased 13x9 inch baking dish.
Whisk together eggs, milk, and remaining 1 tsp salt. Pour evenly over potato mixture.
Bake at 350° for 35–40 minutes.

recipes.title: Huevos Rancheros Pizza
ingredients: 1 can (4 oz) chopped green chilies, drained
1 Tbsp finely chopped cilantro or fresh parsley
steps: Preheat oven to 450°F. In large bowl combine eggs, chilies, scallions, cilantro, and milk.
In large skillet melt butter and cook egg mixture until eggs are set, stirring frequently. Place Boboli on baking sheet. Evenly spread pizza sauce over crust.
Spoon eggs over sauce. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake 10 minutes or until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Yorkshire Pudding
steps: Preheat oven to 425°. Coat a 9x13 pan with drippings. Mix flour, milk, eggs, and salt for 5 min. Cover. Chill for 1 hour. Heat drippings until hot and sizzling.
Spoon chilled mix (after a quick beating right out of the fridge) onto drippings. Bake 20 min at 425°, lower to 375° and bake another 15 min.
DO NOT OPEN OVEN until done — no peeking!

recipes.title: Basic Muffins
steps: Mix dry ingredients. Make well in center. Combine egg, milk, and oil. Add all at once to flour. Stir till moistened. Fill muffin tins ⅔ full. Bake 400° for 20 to 25 min.

recipes.title: Candy Cane Bread
ingredients: Pressurized red and green decorator icing (optional)
Enough milk to make drizzling consistency
steps: Stir together flour, brown sugar, baking powder, and salt. Cut in butter till mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Add nuts. Mix egg and milk.
Stir into dry mixture just till moistened. On a lightly floured surface pat dough to a 10x7-inch rectangle, ½-inch thick. Cut crosswise into 1-inch strips.
Twist each strip by holding both ends. Bend 1 end to form a candy cane. Place several inches apart on greased baking sheet. Bake at 425° 10 minutes or till light brown.
Transfer to rack. Cool. Coat each cane with Powdered Sugar Icing. Decorate with decorator icing, cinnamon candies, or peppermint candies as desired.

recipes.title: Cheese Straws
steps: Sift flour, salt, and ginger into a bowl. Cut in margarine as you would for a pie pastry. Lightly stir in cheese and sesame seeds. Add Worcestershire to the cold water.
Sprinkle over the flour mixture, tossing with a fork.
(If dough isn't moistened enough to hold together, add more water.) Form into 2 balls, roll each out on lightly floured board to ⅛" thickness.
Cut into strips, squares, circles, or whatever! Place on ungreased sheet and bake at 400° for 10–20 min or till golden brown and crisp.

recipes.title: Citrus Nut Bread
ingredients: ¼ tsp finely shredded lemon peel
steps: In mixing bowl thoroughly stir together flour, sugar, salt, and baking soda. Combine egg, orange peel and juice, lemon peel and juice, and cooking oil.
Add egg mixture to dry ingredients, stirring just till dry ingredients are moistened. Fold in nuts. Turn batter into greased 8x4x2-inch loaf pan.
Bake in 350° oven for 50 to 60 minutes or till done. Cool in pan 10 minutes; remove from pan and cool completely on wire rack.
Wrap in foil and store overnight before slicing.

recipes.title: Festive Three C Bread
steps: Stir together thoroughly all-purpose flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt.
Combine eggs, oil, and milk; add to the flour mixture and stir just till blended. Stir in shredded carrot, coconut, maraschino cherries, raisins, and pecans.
Turn into 4 well-greased and floured 16-ounce fruit or vegetable cans. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes. Remove from cans; cool thoroughly on rack.
Wrap in foil; store in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Honey Oatmeal Bread
ingredients: 2 pkgs yeast dissolved in ⅓ cup water
steps: Pour boiling water over oatmeal. Let stand ½ hr. Meanwhile dissolve yeast in ⅓ cup water. Add oil, honey, salt, and yeast to oats. Then add 2 cups flour.
Next add 2 cups wheat flour and 2 cups white flour. Knead. Raise to double. Punch and divide in half. Make loaves and raise to double. Bake 350° for 50 min.

recipes.title: Lemon Tea Bread
steps: Cream butter and sugar together. Add eggs and almond extract. Alternate dry ingredients with milk mixture. Fold in lemon peel and walnuts.
Bake in greased loaf pan at 325° for 70 min.
Put on lemon glaze while warm. Let stand 10 min before removing from pan.

recipes.title: Mom's Sweet Cornbread
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Combine flour, sugar, cornmeal, baking powder, and salt. Set aside.
In a small bowl, combine milk, whisked eggs, oil, and melted butter. Mix until well blended.
Add all at once to dry ingredients, stirring until moistened.
Pour into a greased 8x8 pan, or fill muffin pans ⅔ full.
Bake cornbread 30–35 min, or muffins 18–20 min.

recipes.title: Pennsylvania Dutch Christmas Loaves
ingredients: ⅓ cup finely chopped candied citron
½ cup finely chopped blanched almonds
steps: In large mixer bowl combine 2 cups of the flour and the yeast. In saucepan heat the milk, butter, sugar, and salt just till warm (115° to 120°).
Stir into flour with the egg. Beat at low speed for ½ minute, scraping sides of bowl. Beat 3 minutes at high speed. Add raisins, currants, and citron; mix well.
By hand stir in enough remaining flour to make a moderately soft dough. Turn out onto a lightly floured surface; knead 5 to 8 minutes till smooth and elastic.
Place in a lightly greased bowl; turn once to grease surface. Cover; let rise in a warm place about 1½ hours or till double. Punch down; divide into 4 portions.
Shape into 6-inch loaves. Place on greased baking sheet 3 inches apart. Cover; let rise again about 1 hour.
Bake in 375° oven for 20 to 30 minutes or till loaves sound hollow when lightly tapped. Cool; drizzle with Glaze. Sprinkle almonds on top.

recipes.title: Pizza Crust
steps: Dissolve yeast in warm water, let stand. Add ½ of flour to yeast and water. Beat till smooth.
Add salt and shortening with other half of flour, mix together then beat hard.
Roll dough into ball, let stand covered for 5–10 min. Grease pans. Divide dough and press into pans. Add topping of any kind. Bake 20–30 min at 375°. Makes 2 pizzas.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Muffins
steps: Cream butter and sugar. Add honey, egg, and pumpkin. Mix well. Combine dry ingredients and mix into pumpkin mixture. Add nuts. Bake at 400° for 18 min.
Dough can be stored in airtight bowl in refrigerator and baked as needed.

recipes.title: Scones
ingredients: ½ cup goodies of choice (raisins, dried fruit, chocolate chips, etc.)
steps: Mix dry ingredients with spoon. Cut in butter till fine. Beat egg with whisk. Add cream and goodies to egg. Add wet to dry — do not overwork.
Make 2 balls; place on greased cookie sheet and flatten to 1½". Brush with egg. Bake 375°F for 12–15 min.

recipes.title: Sourdough Biscuits
ingredients: 2 pkgs dry yeast, dissolved in 1 cup warm water
4 cups flour, or more if needed
steps: Stir well together until oil is blended. Add 4 cups flour or more if needed. Add salt, baking powder, and baking soda. Mix well.
Dough can be stored in airtight bowl in refrigerator to bake later. Pinch off as needed. Bake in 375° oven for 20 min.

recipes.title: Whole Wheat Bread
ingredients: ½ cup firmly packed brown sugar
steps: Soften yeast in warm water in large mixing bowl. Combine brown sugar, shortening, salt, and boiling water. Add cold water; cool to lukewarm. Slowly add yeast.
Add whole wheat flour, then all-purpose flour to make stiff dough. Knead 7 to 10 min. Place in greased bowl; cover; let rise 2 hours.
Punch down dough; cover; let rise 30 min. Divide. Put into 2 bread pans; cover. Let rise again 1¼ to 1½ hours. Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 min until golden brown.
Remove; cool.

recipes.title: Yeast Bread
steps: Dissolve yeast in warm water; set aside. Put all other ingredients in a large bowl and mix with an electric mixer.
Add yeast and 1 cup flour; blend with mixer until smooth. Add another cup of flour and still use mixer.
After about 2 cups of flour you will have to use a spoon or hands to mix. Rise twice in bowl and once in bread pan. Bake 350° for 45 min to 1 hour depending on loaf size.
Rolls 20–25 min. Brush with butter after you take out of the oven.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
steps: Cream together butter and sugar. Beat in eggs. Combine dry ingredients in separate bowl. Add ½ of the dry ingredients to creamed mixture.
Add zucchini — mixture will look curdled. Add remaining dry ingredients, nuts, and vanilla. Mix well. Pour into greased loaf pan. Bake 50–60 min.

recipes.title: Big Rock Candy Mountain Stew
steps: Brown sausage and beef; drain. Add potatoes, onion, carrots, garlic, water, peppers, and tomatoes. Cook 50 min.
Serve with a scoop of sour cream on top of your bowl of stew.

recipes.title: Carrot Soup with Orange and Tarragon
cardImages: uploads/Carrot Soup with Orange and Tarragon.jpg
steps: Melt butter in heavy large pot over medium heat. Add carrots and onion; sauté until onion is soft, about 8 minutes. Add broth; cover and bring to boil.
Reduce heat, uncover, and simmer until carrots are tender, about 10 minutes.
Working in batches, purée soup in blender until very smooth. Return soup to pot. Stir in orange juice, brandy, and chopped tarragon.
Simmer 5 minutes for flavors to blend. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Garnish soup with tarragon sprigs and serve.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Soup
ingredients: 2 pts (6 cups) water or chicken stock
steps: Cook cauliflower in water or stock for 12 min. Remove cauliflower. Save stock.
Melt butter, stir in flour, cook 1–2 min. Add 2½ cups of stock, stir to blend. Beat egg yolks and add to flour mixture. Add nutmeg.
Mix dumpling ingredients together — form into balls. Poach in soup 3–5 min before adding cream. Serve with bread.

recipes.title: Onion Soup
steps: Sauté onion in margarine in large skillet. Add broth, water, and pepper. Cover, simmer 15 min. Pour soup into six 8 oz oven safe bowls.
Top with toast, Swiss cheese, and Parmesan. Place in oven at 425° for 10 min or until cheese is melted. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Simple Turkey Chili
recipes.time: Prep: 15 min · Cook: 45 min · Ready in: 1 hr
recipes.note: "This is a very simple and hearty chili with plenty of flavor. It's even better the second day! I serve this with lowfat Cheddar cheese and lowfat sour cream. It's also delicious with crackers."
ingredients: 1 (28 oz) can kidney beans — drained and rinsed
steps: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Place turkey in the pot and cook until evenly brown. Stir in onion and cook until tender.
Season with chili powder, paprika, oregano, cumin, salt, cayenne pepper, and garlic.
Pour water into the pot. Mix in tomatoes and kidney beans. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Turkey Chili
ingredients: ½ cup dried kidney beans, cooked
30 Fat Free Premium Saltine Crackers for serving
steps: In large heavy pot, brown turkey; pour off any excess fat. Add onion, green pepper, and garlic; cook 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add beans, water, tomatoes, tomato paste, chili powder, oregano, cumin, and red pepper; cover. Simmer for 1½ hours, stirring occasionally. Serve hot with crackers.

recipes.title: Vegetable Chowder
ingredients: 2 medium carrots, peeled, sliced and halved (about 1 cup)
2 medium potatoes, peeled and diced (about 2 cups)
steps: In large saucepan over medium-high heat, cook onion in margarine until tender. Add chicken broth, carrots, potatoes, green beans, parsley, tarragon, and pepper.
Heat to a boil; reduce heat. Simmer 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Serve hot with crackers.

recipes.title: Angel Hair with Smoked Salmon in Tomato-Herb Sauce
cardImages: uploads/Angel Hair with Smoked Salmon in Tomato-Herb Sauce.jpg
ingredients: 2¾ cups seeded and chopped tomatoes (2 medium), divided
steps: Cut salmon with the grain into ½-inch wide strips; reserve. Cook pasta as package directs.
Meanwhile in large skillet, stir and cook garlic in hot oil over medium-high heat until golden.
Add 2 cups tomatoes, wine, capers, dill weed, and basil; stir and cook until mixture is hot. Drain pasta; place in large serving bowl.
Toss angel hair with tomato mixture. Add salmon and cheese; toss gently. Garnish with remaining tomatoes and parsley if desired.

recipes.title: Antipasto Pizza
ingredients: ½ cup roasted chopped red peppers
6 thin salami slices, cut in strips
½ green pepper, cut in strips
steps: Preheat oven to 450°. Place Boboli on baking sheet. Top with ½ cup Mozzarella cheese and pizza sauce. Place mushrooms and roasted red peppers on Boboli.
Garnish with salami strips and olives. Place green pepper strips along edge of Boboli. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake 10 minutes or until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Azteca Casserole
ingredients: 1 can (4 oz) chopped green chilies, drained
steps: Cut tortillas in half. In skillet, heat oil until hot. Add 2 or 3 pieces of tortilla and fry on both sides until crisp. Remove and drain between paper towels.
Repeat with remaining tortilla pieces, adding oil if necessary.
Combine tomato sauce, chilies, and cumin. Arrange ⅓ of the tortilla pieces in an overlapping layer on the bottom of a 3-quart casserole.
Top with half the chicken, a third of the tomato sauce mixture, and sour cream. Repeat layers and top with remaining tortillas, sauce, sour cream, and cheese.
Bake in preheated 350° for 35 min or until hot. Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken Broccoli Divan
steps: In 2-qt oblong baking dish arrange broccoli and chicken. Combine soup and milk. Pour over broccoli and chicken. Top with cheese and bread crumbs.
Bake at 450°F for 20 min or until hot and bubbling. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Chicken Over Rice
ingredients: Pinch each: onion salt, garlic salt, salt, pepper
Less than ¼ cup lemon juice
steps: Season chicken before frying. Brown onion and chicken (cut in 4ths.) in oil. Mix soups and broccoli, milk, and lemon juice.
Pour over chicken in frying pan after chicken is browned. Simmer on low 1 to 1½ hours. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Chicken Pot Pie
ingredients: 8 oz veggies (mix of carrots, peas, green beans, corn)
steps: Cook chicken: Season chicken with salt and pepper. Add the chicken to a large saucepan and cover it with water.
Bring to a simmer and cook until it's just barely cooked through, then remove the chicken to a plate.
Allow it to cool for a few minutes before chopping into bite-size pieces. Reserve about 1¾ cups of the water in a measuring cup, and discard the rest.
Chicken pot pie filling: Add onions, celery, and butter to the saucepan and cook for a few minutes, until soft and translucent.
Stir in the flour, salt, pepper, garlic powder, bouillon, and celery seed. Slowly stir in the reserved water and milk. Simmer over medium-low heat until thick.
Add chopped chicken and vegetables. Taste and season with more salt, pepper, bouillon, or garlic powder if needed.
Allow mixture to cool (so that it's not hot when poured into the pie crust).
Preheat oven to 425°F.
Roll out bottom pie crust: Divide pie dough in half. Take one half of dough and place on a lightly floured counter.
Use a rolling pin to roll dough into a large circle, about 12 inches in diameter. Place in a 9-inch pie pan.
Assemble: Add cooled chicken pot pie filling. Roll out second pie crust and place over the top of the filling.
Seal edges of the two crusts together and crimp them, if desired. Use a sharp knife to make a slit in the top pie crust to allow steam to escape.
Bake for 40–50 minutes, or until the top crust is golden brown and filling is bubbly.
Rest and serve: Allow to rest 15 min. Serve!

recipes.title: Chicken and Cheese Enchiladas
steps: Preheat oven to 350°. Grease 9x13 pan. Mix chicken and half the cheese. Roll up in tortillas and place in pan.
In sauce pan, melt butter, stir in flour and cook 1 min. Add broth and whisk until smooth. Heat over med heat until thick and bubbly. Stir in sour cream and chilies.
Pour over enchiladas and top with remaining cheese. Bake 22 min covered — remove cover and cook 3 min more.

recipes.title: Enchilada Pie
steps: Sauté onions and garlic in oil until brown. Add burger and cook until brown. Sprinkle flour over meat and stir until well blended.
Add tomato sauce, stock or water, olives, chili powder, salt, and pepper to taste. Simmer 20 min.
Cover bottom of casserole with sauce. Place tortillas on sauce and cover with more sauce and shredded cheese. Repeat until all is used up, ending with cheese.
Bake in oven at 350° for 45 min. Can also put chopped green onions on when you add cheese.

recipes.title: Foolproof Swiss Steak
ingredients: 1 Reynolds Oven Bag, large size (14" x 20")
1 to 1½ pounds boneless beef round steak, ½-inch thick
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F. Shake flour in Reynolds Oven Bag; place in 13x9x2-inch baking pan. Add tomatoes, sugar, mustard, salt, and pepper to oven bag.
Squeeze bag to blend in flour. Pound steak to ⅛ to ¼-inch thickness. Cut steak in 4 pieces. Add steak to oven bag. Turn bag to coat steak with sauce.
Arrange steak in an even layer. Close bag with nylon tie; cut six ½-inch slits in top. Bake 45 to 50 minutes or until steak is tender.

recipes.title: Impossible Cheeseburger Pie
steps: Heat oven to 400°. Cook ground beef and onions; drain. Stir in salt. Spread in greased 9" pie plate; sprinkle with cheese.
Stir remaining ingredients with fork until blended. Pour into plate. Bake 25 min or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

recipes.title: Italian Sausage and Mushroom Pizza
ingredients: ¾ pound Italian sausage, thinly sliced
steps: Preheat oven to 450°F. In large skillet, lightly brown sausage. Add onion and mushrooms and cook until vegetables are tender, about 5 min. Drain excess fat.
Add pizza sauce; simmer 15 minutes. Place Boboli on baking sheet. Evenly spoon sausage, mushrooms, and green pepper slices over Boboli. Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese.
Bake 10 minutes or until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Make It Easy Chicken
ingredients: 1 Reynolds Oven Bag, large size (14" x 20")
2 medium red potatoes, cut in wedges
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F. Shake flour in Reynolds Oven Bag; place in 13x9x2-inch baking pan. Add onion soup mix and water to oven bag. Squeeze bag to blend in flour.
Add carrots, potatoes, and green pepper; turn bag to coat vegetables with sauce. Sprinkle chicken with seasonings; add to oven bag.
Arrange chicken and vegetables in an even layer. Close bag with nylon tie; cut six ½-inch slits in top. Bake 55 to 60 minutes or until chicken is tender.

recipes.title: Meatballs with Rice
steps: In bowl beat egg and add ¼ cup of the tomato soup. Stir in rice, onion, parsley, ground beef, Worcestershire sauce, salt, and pepper. Make into meatballs.
In small bowl stir together remaining soup and ½ cup water. Pour over meatballs in frying pan. Bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer 35–40 min.

recipes.title: Mexican Chicken Casserole
steps: Mix soups, milk, and salsa together. Layer tortillas — chicken — sauce — tortillas — chicken — sauce — tortillas — chicken — sauce. Top with cheese.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Northwest Hazelnut Turkey Casserole
ingredients: 1 can (10½ oz) condensed cream of celery soup
steps: Melt butter in small skillet; add hazelnuts and green pepper; cook until hazelnuts are toasted and pepper is tender.
Mix together celery soup, milk, turkey, pimiento, salt, and ¾ of the hazelnut-green pepper mixture. Pour into a buttered 1½ qt casserole.
Top with remaining hazelnut-pepper mixture. Bake at 350° for 15–20 min or microwave covered on full power for 8–10 min. Garnish with parsley; serve over cooked noodles.
Toast hazelnuts for full flavor!

recipes.title: Pasta with Spinach Pesto
ingredients: 2 cups torn packed fresh spinach leaves (about 4 oz)
½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese
½ cup pine nuts or slivered almonds
12 oz penne or other tubular pasta
steps: In food processor or blender, place spinach, oil, cheese, basil, garlic powder, garlic, and pine nuts. Pulse on-and-off until almost smooth; reserve.
Prepare pasta as package directs; drain. Toss pesto with hot pasta. Season with salt. To serve, sprinkle with remaining pine nuts and additional cheese if desired.

recipes.title: Pizza
ingredients: A little more water as needed
Oregano and black pepper to taste
Thin slices of lowfat Mozzarella cheese
steps: Mix crust ingredients thoroughly. Place in bowl and let rise. Punch down. Work into circle. Let rest 10 min. Place in 500° oven for 3–4 min.
Spread topping onto crust. Add thin slices of lowfat Mozzarella cheese on top. Bake at 500° till done. Garnish with parsley. Brush sides with milk.

recipes.title: Sautéed Chicken with Tomato-Saffron Vinaigrette on Frisée
cardImages: uploads/Sautéed Chicken with Tomato-Saffron Vinaigrette on Frisée.jpg
ingredients: 3 Tbsp white balsamic vinegar or rice vinegar
steps: Mix vinegar, ½ tsp paprika, and saffron in medium bowl. Mix in 3 Tbsp oil, shallots, and 1 Tbsp thyme. Stir in tomatoes. Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Heat remaining 1 Tbsp oil in large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Sprinkle chicken with remaining 1 tsp paprika, 1 Tbsp thyme, and salt and pepper.
Add to skillet; sauté until cooked through, turning often, about 12 minutes. Transfer chicken to work surface. Divide frisée among 4 plates.
Slice chicken; fan atop frisée. Spoon vinaigrette over.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Lasagna
steps: Cook sausage and onion in skillet 6–8 min, till done. Stir in tomato sauce, basil, and salt. Mix 1 cup Mozzarella, the ricotta, and Parmesan cheese.
Refrigerate remaining.
Spoon ¼ sausage mix into slow cooker. Top with 5 noodles, break to fit. Spread ½ cheese mix and ¼ sausage mix.
Top with 5 noodles, remaining cheese mix, and ¼ sausage mix. Cook on low setting 4–6 hrs, or till tender.
Sprinkle with remaining Mozzarella cheese, cover, let stand 10 min. Cut and serve.

recipes.title: Spring Garden Fettuccine
ingredients: 1 lg red bell pepper, seeded and cut into 2-inch strips
½ lb fresh asparagus, cut diagonally into 2-inch lengths
3 oz sliced prosciutto, cut into ½-inch strips
1 cup dry white wine or canned vegetable broth
1 jar (6 oz) marinated artichoke hearts, drained
steps: Cook fettuccine as package directs.
Meanwhile in large skillet, stir and cook red bell pepper and asparagus in hot oil over medium-high heat, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are tender-crisp, about 5 minutes.
Add wine, artichoke hearts, oregano, basil, and crushed red pepper; bring sauce to boil. Stir in prosciutto. Drain fettuccine; place in serving bowl.
Toss with fettuccine and cheese.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Turkey
ingredients: 5 oz skinned and boned turkey breast, cut into 2x1-inch strips
½ cup diagonally-sliced carrot (¼-inch-thick slices), blanched
steps: In small skillet heat oil over high heat; add garlic, then turkey and stir-fry until turkey is browned.
Reduce heat; add remaining ingredients, cover, and simmer 5 to 10 minutes. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Sweet and Sour Meatballs
ingredients: 1 (20 oz) can pineapple chunks, drained, reserving juice
steps: In large skillet, combine oil and drained pineapple juice, adding water if necessary to make 1 cup.
In a small bowl combine cornstarch, soy sauce, vinegar, water, and brown sugar. Stir into juice mix. Cook over med-high heat 5–7 min until thick.
Add meatballs, pineapple, and green pepper. Simmer 20 min. Serve over hot cooked rice.

recipes.title: Taco Delight
ingredients: Shredded lettuce, chopped tomatoes, sour cream, grated cheese, avocado, and tortilla chips for serving
steps: Brown ground beef and onion in large skillet. Add salsa, tomato sauce, and bouillon. Bring to boil. Stir in rice, cover. Remove from heat, let stand 5 min.
Fluff with fork. Serve with lettuce, tomatoes, sour cream, cheese, avocado, and tortilla chips. 4 servings.

recipes.title: Tater Tot Casserole
ingredients: 1 sm roll Hot Jimmy Dean sausage
steps: Brown hamburger and sausage. Drain, set aside. Empty cans of soup in bowl, add ½ cup milk. In large pan layer: tater tots, soup, cheese until gone. Bake at 400° for 1 hr.
Stir approximately every 10–15 min.

recipes.title: Tortellini con Melanzane (Eggplant)
ingredients: 1 (1½ to 1¾ lb) large eggplant, unpeeled and diced (about 9 cups)
1 medium onion, cut into thin wedges
1 can (28 oz) ready-cut chopped tomatoes, undrained
1 package (9 oz) fresh or frozen tortellini
¼ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese
steps: In large skillet, stir and cook eggplant and onion in hot oil over medium-high heat for 10 minutes. Add undrained tomatoes, garlic, Italian herb seasoning, and basil.
Cook covered over medium heat for 15 minutes or until onions are tender. Meanwhile cook tortellini as package directs. Drain. Add to eggplant; toss gently to mix.
Serve in pasta bowl; sprinkle with cheese.

recipes.title: Canning Salsa
ingredients: 7 quarts tomatoes, cut into bite-size pieces
steps: Mix well. Put into jars. Seal. Process in water bath 25 min.

recipes.title: Canning Tomato Sauce
steps: Put tomatoes into saucepan and cook down. Sauté onions, garlic, and green peppers in olive oil until transparent. Add to tomatoes.
Add pepper, parsley, basil, bouillon, salt, and sugar. Scoop into blender, blend well. Return to saucepan and let thicken. Put into jars, seal.
Process in water bath as needed.

recipes.title: Mama's Cowboy Beans
ingredients: 4 (16 oz) cans baked beans, or homemade
steps: Sauté onion till translucent. Add ground sausage and cook till done. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Drain.
Combine ground sausage, bacon, baked beans, green chilis, and BBQ sauce. Add brown sugar, garlic, chili powder, and hot pepper sauce.
Cook on high 2 hours, or 4–5 hours slowly.

recipes.title: Salsa
steps: Mix all ingredients together. Use fresh or process for canning.

recipes.title: Spiced Oranges
recipes.note: Serve chilled with meats, poultry, or fish
steps: Peel fruit, reserving peel from 2 oranges. Remove white membrane from reserved peel; cut peel into thin strips.
In a saucepan combine reserved peel, baking soda, and 1 cup water. Simmer covered for 10 minutes; remove. Add grapefruit, oranges, and raisins.
Bring to boiling; reduce heat. Simmer uncovered for 10 minutes. Cool slightly. Spoon into jars or moisture-vaporproof containers.
Refrigerate up to 2 weeks or freeze up to 1 year.

recipes.title: Sweet Yams
steps: Combine all ingredients and bake 20 min at 375°.
Crumble topping on top. Cook til just melted.

recipes.title: Creamy Cucumber
steps: Combine all ingredients. Chill and serve as a dip or dressing.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad
steps: Mix Cool Whip, sour cream, and pudding together. Fold in all fruit. Chill and serve.

recipes.title: Artichoke-Chili Dip
ingredients: 1 (14 oz) can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped
1 (4 oz) can green chili peppers, rinsed, seeded, and chopped
Tortilla chips and breadsticks for serving
steps: Combine the chopped artichoke hearts, chopped chili peppers, cheese, and mayonnaise or salad dressing. Turn mixture into an 8-inch round baking dish.
Bake in a 350° oven about 20 minutes or till heated through. Serve warm with tortilla chips and breadsticks.

recipes.title: Brie en Croûte
recipes.time: Thaw: 40 min · Prep: 15 min · Bake: 20 min · Stand: 1 hr
ingredients: ½ of a 17.3 oz package Frozen Puff Pastry Sheets (1 sheet)
steps: Thaw the pastry sheet at room temperature for 40 minutes or until easy to handle. Heat oven to 400°F. Lightly grease a baking sheet.
Stir the egg and water with a fork in a small bowl.
Unfold the pastry sheet on a lightly floured surface. Roll the sheet into a 14-inch square. Cut off the corners to make a circle.
Center the almonds if desired, and parsley on the pastry. Top with the cheese. Brush the edge of the pastry with the egg mixture. Fold two opposite sides over the cheese.
Trim the remaining two sides to 2 inches from the edge of the cheese. Fold those two sides onto the cheese. Press edges to seal.
Place seam-side down on the prepared baking sheet. Brush with the egg mixture.
Bake for 20 minutes or until golden. Let stand for 1 hour before serving. Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
steps: Shred cheddar cheese into the small bowl of an electric mixer. Add cream cheese and butter; beat until blended. Add garlic powder and beat until creamy.
Cover and chill cheese mixture for about 3 hours or until firm enough to shape into ball. Shape into smooth ball.
Sprinkle nuts on wax paper and roll the ball in the nuts pressing lightly. Wrap ball in airtight clear plastic film and refrigerate or freeze until needed.
Allow frozen cheese ball to stand at room temperature, unwrapped, 3 or 4 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Cheese and Onion Tart
ingredients: 2 oz lard, 2 oz butter, salt, 2 Tbs water
steps: Make pastry. Cook onions in salt water long enough to make tender, about ½ hour. Drain most of water off.
Layer cheese — onion — cheese in dish. Top with pastry. Bake for ½ to ¾ hr at 400°F.

recipes.title: Cheesy Zucchini and Red Onion Flatbread
cardImages: uploads/Cheesy Zucchini and Red Onion Flatbread.jpg
ingredients: ¾ cup garlic-and-herb cheese spread (such as Alouette), divided
¾ cup finely grated Parmesan cheese, divided
3 Tbsp chopped fresh Italian parsley, divided
1 (7 to 8-inch) zucchini, cut crosswise into ⅛-inch-thick rounds, divided
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line baking sheet with parchment paper; spray with nonstick spray. Unroll dough onto parchment.
Spread half of herb cheese over 1 long half of dough, leaving ½-inch plain border. Sprinkle with half of Parmesan and 2 Tbsp parsley.
Fold plain half of dough over filled half (do not seal edges). Spread remaining herb cheese over top; sprinkle with remaining Parmesan.
Cut onion into ⅛-inch-thick rounds. Arrange rows of zucchini and onion on top. Brush vegetables with oil; sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Bake until puffed and deep brown at edges, about 24 minutes. Sprinkle with 1 Tbsp parsley.

recipes.title: Clotted Cream
steps: Using a whisk attachment on the mixer, whip heavy cream until stiff peaks form.
Remove from mixer, and hand whisk in the sour cream and confectioners' sugar until just combined. Store in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Garden Vegetable Onion Dip
ingredients: 1 package (4 serving size) dry onion soup mix
steps: Stir together sour cream, onion soup mix, garlic powder, and dill weed until well blended. Stir in grated carrots. Chill at least 1 hour before serving.

recipes.title: Guacamole Dip
steps: Peel and slice avocados. Place in small bowl of electric mixer. Add remaining ingredients.
Beat on low speed until avocado slices are mashed and all ingredients are well combined. Chill 1 hour. Garnish with chopped tomatoes or green onions if desired.

recipes.title: Salmon Spread
ingredients: ¼ lb smoked salmon, finely chopped
⅛ tsp freshly cracked black pepper
steps: Mix all ingredients together until well combined. Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Spinach Ricotta Pie (Dip)
ingredients: ½ tsp dried basil leaves, crushed
½ tsp dried oregano leaves, crushed
steps: Preheat oven to 350°. Place spinach and onions in small saucepan. Cook 5 min or until tender.
Beat cheeses and seasonings in small mixing bowl at medium speed with electric mixer until well blended. Stir in spinach mixture. Spread into 9-inch pie plate.
Bake 15–20 min or until thoroughly heated. Top with remaining ingredients. Serve with crisp rye crackers or bagel chips.

recipes.title: Banana-Nut Cake
ingredients: 1 cup (2 medium-size) mashed, very ripe bananas
½ cup buttermilk or sour milk
steps: Grease and flour bottoms of two 8-inch layer pans. Sift flour with sugar, baking powder, soda, and salt into large mixing bowl. Add shortening, eggs, and bananas.
Beat well at lowest speed of mixer for ½ min.
Add buttermilk and vanilla extract. Continue beating ½ min at low speed. Stir in nuts.
Pour batter into pans. Bake at 350° for 30–35 minutes, until cake springs back when lightly touched in center.
When cool, frost with Creamy Butter Frosting or Fluffy White Frosting.

recipes.title: Bible Cake
steps: Cream butter and sugar. Beat in eggs. Add milk. Sift and add flour, baking powder, and salt to creamed mixture. Add honey and stir in. Fold in figs, almonds, raisins, and spices.
Bake in slow oven.

recipes.title: Blueberry Bundt Cake
ingredients: 1 Duncan Hines golden butter recipe cake mix
1 (8 oz) cream cheese, low fat (room temp)
steps: Grease and flour pan. Mix and beat 2 min. Fold in blueberries. Bake 1 hr. Cool 25 min.

recipes.title: Boose Cake
ingredients: ¼ cup water — boil and cool 5 minutes, keep in ¼ cup water
½ cup salad oil — add water and raisins
steps: Bake 1 hr or longer at 300°.

recipes.title: Dark Fruitcake
ingredients: ½ tsp each ground nutmeg, allspice, and cloves
16 oz diced mixed candied fruits and peels (2½ cups)
1 (8 oz) package pitted whole dates, snipped (1⅓ cups)
8 oz whole red or green candied cherries (1½ cups)
steps: Grease three 8x4x2-inch loaf pans or two 10x3½x2½-inch loaf dessert pans. Line bottom and sides of pans with brown paper to prevent overbrowning; grease paper.
In saucepan melt butter or margarine; cool. Stir together flour, baking powder, cinnamon, nutmeg, allspice, cloves, and 1 tsp salt.
Add mixed fruits and peels, dates, cherries, raisins, almonds, pecans, and pineapple; mix till well coated. Beat eggs till foamy.
Add brown sugar, orange juice, molasses, and butter; beat till blended. Stir into fruit mixture.
Turn batter into prepared pans, filling each about ¾ full. Bake in a 300° oven about 2 hours or till cakes test done.
Cover all pans loosely with foil after 1 hour of baking to prevent overbrowning. Place cakes on wire racks; cool thoroughly. Remove from pans.
Wrap in wine-, brandy-, or fruit juice-moistened cheesecloth. Overwrap with foil. Store in the refrigerator for 3 to 4 weeks before serving.
Remoisten the cheesecloth once a week.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Cake
ingredients: ½ cup margarine or butter, softened
steps: Stir together flour, soda, salt, cinnamon, and nutmeg. Beat the ½ cup margarine and the granulated sugar. Beat in eggs. Stir in apples and flour mixture.
Spread in greased 9x13x2-inch baking pan. Bake at 350°F about 45 min or until done.
Frosting: Beat cream cheese, 1 Tbsp margarine, and vanilla. Gradually add confectioners' sugar, beating until smooth. If frosting is too thick, add 1 to 2 tsp milk.
Spread on cooled cake.

recipes.title: Golden Glow Cake
steps: Grease and flour bottoms of two 8 or 9-inch layer pans. Sift flour with sugar, baking powder, and salt into large mixing bowl. Add shortening and milk.
Blend well at lowest speed of mixer. Beat 1½ min at low speed or 225 strokes with a spoon. Add eggs and vanilla extract; continue beating 1 min. Pour batter into pans.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes, until cake is golden brown and springs back when lightly touched in center.

recipes.title: Peaches 'n' Crumb Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg (1¼ tsp) Fleischmann's active dry yeast
⅛ cup very hot tap water (85°F)
¼ cup firmly packed light brown sugar
steps: Combine ¾ cup flour, sugar, salt, and dissolved yeast. Add 3 Tbs softened margarine and hot tap water to dry ingredients. Beat 2 min at medium speed.
Add eggs and ½ cup flour. Beat 2 min. Stir in enough flour to make a stiff batter. Spread in greased 9-in square pan.
Combine remaining ¼ cup flour, brown sugar, cinnamon, and nutmeg. Cut in 2 Tbs margarine until crumbly. Sprinkle over cake. Arrange peach slices on top.
Cover, let rise in warm place, free from draft, until double in bulk (about 1 hr).
Bake at 400°F for 35 min or until done. Cool 10 min, remove and cool on wire rack. Sprinkle with confectioners' sugar.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Spice Cake
steps: Mix cake ingredients together. Grease and flour pan.
Add topping. Bake at 350° for 35 min.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Swirl Cheesecake
ingredients: 2 (8 oz) pkgs Light Neufchâtel Cheese, softened
steps: Combine crumbs and margarine; press onto bottom and sides of 9-inch springform pan.
Combine neufchâtel cheese, ½ cup sugar, and vanilla; mix at medium speed until well blended. Add eggs one at a time, mixing well after each addition.
Reserve 1 cup neufchâtel cheese mixture; add pumpkin, remaining sugar, and spices to remaining neufchâtel cheese mixture. Mix well.
Layer half of pumpkin mixture and half of neufchâtel cheese mixture over crust. Repeat layers. Cut through batter with knife several times for marble effect.
Bake at 350° for 55 minutes. Loosen cake from rim of pan; cool before removing rim. Chill. 10 to 12 servings.

recipes.title: Rainbow Poke Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg (3 oz) raspberry Jello — dissolved in boiling water
1 pkg (3 oz) lime Jello — dissolved in boiling water
steps: Prepare and bake cake as directed. Remove from pans, cool completely. Place back into cake pans.
Prick cakes with a fork. Pour raspberry Jello slowly over half the cake. Pour lime Jello slowly over the other half.
Refrigerate until set. Top with Cool Whip before serving.

recipes.title: Red Velvet Cake
ingredients: 2 Tbs cocoa + 2 oz red food coloring (mixed into paste)
steps: Cream shortening, sugar, and eggs. Add cocoa paste to creamed mixture. Alternate flour with buttermilk mixture. Fold in baking soda and vinegar — do not beat.
Bake at 350°.
Cook flour and milk together, stirring constantly, until thick. Cool completely.
Beat butter, sugar, and vanilla until fluffy. Add cooled flour mixture and beat until spreading consistency — should look like whipped cream.

recipes.title: Cherry Cream Pie
ingredients: ⅓ cup lemon juice from concentrate
steps: In large mixer bowl beat cheese until fluffy. Beat in sweetened condensed milk until smooth. Stir in lemon juice and vanilla. Pour into crust. Chill 3 hours.
Top with cherry filling.

recipes.title: Fresh Blueberry Pie
steps: Combine sugar, cornstarch, and salt in saucepan. Blend in water and 1 cup blueberries. Bring to boil, cook stirring constantly until very thick.
Stir in butter and lemon juice. Cool. Fold in remaining blueberries. Chill about one hour.
Beat heavy cream until thick. Add confectioners' sugar and vanilla extract. Spread half of whipped cream over bottom of baked pastry shell. Top with blueberry filling.
Chill 1–2 hours before serving. Garnish with remaining whipped cream.

recipes.title: Frontier Hazelnut Vegetable Pie
steps: Pre-cook broccoli and cauliflower until almost tender (about 5 minutes). Drain well.
Mix broccoli, cauliflower, spinach, onion, green pepper, and cheese and put into a well-greased 10" pie plate. Top with hazelnuts.
Beat together milk, Bisquick, eggs, garlic salt, and pepper; pour over hazelnuts and vegetables. Bake at 400° for 35 to 40 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.
Toast hazelnuts for full flavor! Ten ounces of frozen chopped broccoli, cauliflower, and spinach may be substituted for fresh. Thaw and drain well. Do not pre-cook.

recipes.title: Lemon Thyme Cream Puffs
recipes.time: Thaw: 40 min · Prep: 20 min · Refrigerate: 1 hr
ingredients: 1 (17.3 oz) package Frozen Puff Pastry Sheets (1 sheet)
steps: Thaw the pastry sheet at room temperature for 40 minutes or until easy to handle. Heat oven to 400°F.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or spray with cooking spray. Stir the egg and water in a small bowl.
Unfold the pastry on a lightly floured surface. Roll into a 12-inch square. Brush with egg mixture. Cut into 36 (2-inch) squares. Sprinkle with sugar.
Place on prepared baking sheet.
Bake for 10 minutes or until golden. Cool completely on a wire rack.
Heat ⅓ cup of the cream and the thyme in a 2-quart saucepan to a boil. Reduce heat and cook for 10 minutes. Remove from heat, let steep 30 minutes.
Strain through a fine sieve. Refrigerate at least 1 hour until chilled.
Beat remaining cream to soft peaks. Add chilled cream mixture and lemon curd. Beat until stiff. Transfer to a pastry bag.
Pipe about 1 heaping Tbsp lemon thyme cream mixture into each pastry.
Melt chocolate in microwave, about 1 minute. Stir until smooth. Drizzle over puffs. Let stand until chocolate sets.

recipes.title: Peach Pie
steps: Prepare pastry for 9-inch lattice-top pie. Combine sugar, flour, nutmeg, cinnamon, and salt. Add to fresh sliced peaches. Line 9-inch pie plate with pastry; fill.
Dot with butter. Adjust lattice crust on top. Crimp edges. Bake 45–50 min in 400° oven. Serve warm with whipped cream or ice cream.

recipes.title: Plain Pastry
ingredients: ## Double Crust or Lattice-Top Pie (8–10 inch)

recipes.title: Sour Cream Peach Pie
ingredients: ⅔–1 cup sugar, plus more for topping
steps: Mix everything together except the peaches.
Add the peaches and pour into the pie shell.
Add the top crust and brush with sugar.
Bake at 400° for 30–40 min.

recipes.title: Strawberry Tiramisú
ingredients: ⅓ cup plus 4 Tbsp Cointreau or other orange liqueur, divided
steps: Whisk preserves, ⅓ cup Cointreau, and orange juice in 2-cup measuring cup. Place mascarpone cheese and 2 Tbsp Cointreau in large bowl; fold just to blend.
Using electric mixer, beat cream, sugar, vanilla, and remaining 2 Tbsp Cointreau to soft peaks. Stir ¼ of whipped cream into mascarpone mixture to lighten.
Fold in remaining whipped cream.
Hull and slice half of strawberries. Spread ½ cup preserve mixture over bottom of 3-quart oblong serving dish or 13x9x2-inch glass baking dish.
Arrange enough ladyfingers over preserve mixture to cover bottom of dish. Spoon ¾ cup preserve mixture over ladyfingers, then spread 2½ cups mascarpone mixture over.
Arrange sliced strawberries over mascarpone mixture. Repeat layering with remaining ladyfingers, preserve mixture, and mascarpone mixture.
Cover with plastic and chill at least 8 hours or overnight.
Slice remaining strawberries. Arrange over tiramisú and serve.

recipes.title: Any Cake Mix Can Be a Cookie
cardImages: uploads/Any Cake Mix Can Be a Cookie.jpg
ingredients: Ingredients the box calls for (use less milk)
1 can (4 oz) chopped jalapeño peppers, drained
steps: Cut back on milk and follow box directions and any cake mix can be a cookie.
Or put a 4 oz can of drained chopped jalapeño peppers in a brownie mix. Follow box directions. These are great! Whole new taste to brownies!

recipes.title: Brown Sugar Cookies
steps: Heat oven to 350°F. Beat shortening, butter, brown sugar, egg, and vanilla in medium bowl with electric mixer on medium speed until creamy.
Stir together flour, baking soda, and salt. Add gradually to creamed mixture, beating on low speed until blended. Shape dough into 1-inch balls.
Place 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheet. Bake 12 to 14 minutes or until golden brown. Cool on baking sheet 2 minutes. Remove to wire rack to cool completely.

recipes.title: Cake Box Cookies
steps: Mix all together and drop by spoonful on pan. Bake at 350° for 10–12 min, or 14 min for crispy cookies.

recipes.title: Chewy Toffee Almond Bars
ingredients: 1¾ cups (10 oz) English Toffee Bits or Bits 'O Brickle
¾ cup sweetened coconut flakes, divided
steps: Heat oven to 350°F. Grease sides of 13x9x2-inch baking pan.
Beat butter and sugar until fluffy. Gradually add flour, beating until well blended. Press dough evenly into prepared pan.
Bake 15–20 minutes or until edges are lightly browned. Meanwhile combine toffee bits and corn syrup in medium saucepan.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until toffee is melted (about 10–12 minutes). Stir in ½ cup almonds and ½ cup coconut.
Spread toffee mixture to within ¼ inch of edges of crust. Sprinkle remaining almonds and coconut over top.
Bake an additional 15 minutes or until bubbly. Cool completely. Cut into bars.

recipes.title: Chocolate Almond Cookies
ingredients: 1 cup (2 sticks) butter or margarine, softened
1 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips or mini chips
steps: Beat butter and 1 cup sugar until fluffy. Add egg, almond extract, and vanilla; beat well.
Combine flour, cocoa, baking powder, baking soda, and salt; blend into butter mixture. Stir in chocolate chips.
Refrigerate dough about 1 hour if needed until firm enough to handle.
Heat oven to 350°F. Shape dough into 1-inch balls; roll in sugar. Place about 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet.
Place three slivered almonds on top of each; press lightly.
Bake 9 to 10 minutes or until set. Cool slightly. Remove from cookie sheet to wire rack. Cool completely.

recipes.title: Chocolate-Covered Cherry Cookies
ingredients: ½ cup butter or margarine, softened
½ cup Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
steps: In large bowl stir together flour, cocoa powder, salt, baking powder, and baking soda. In mixer bowl beat butter and sugar until fluffy. Add egg and vanilla; beat well.
Gradually add dry ingredients; beat till well blended. Shape dough into 1-inch balls; place on ungreased cookie sheet. Press down center of dough with thumb.
Drain maraschino cherries, reserving juice. Place a cherry in the center of each cookie.
In small saucepan combine chocolate pieces and sweetened condensed milk; heat till chocolate is melted. Stir in 4 tsp of the reserved cherry juice.
Spoon about 1 tsp frosting over each cherry, spreading to cover.
(Frosting may be thinned with additional cherry juice if necessary.) Bake in 350° oven about 10 minutes or till done. Remove to wire rack; cool.

recipes.title: Funfetti Cookies
ingredients: 1 (18.9 oz) pkg Pillsbury Moist Supreme Funfetti Cake Mix
½ can Pillsbury Creamy Supreme Funfetti Vanilla Frosting
steps: In large bowl, combine cake mix, oil, and eggs; stir with spoon until thoroughly blended. Shape dough into 1-inch balls; place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets.
With bottom of glass dipped in flour, flatten to ¼-inch thickness.
Bake at 375°F for 6 to 8 minutes or until edges are light golden brown. Cool 1 minute; remove from cookie sheets.
Spread frosting over cookies. Immediately sprinkle each with candy bits from frosting. Let frosting set before storing. Store in tightly covered container.

recipes.title: Holiday Cookie Mix
steps: In Fix-N-Mix bowl combine first 4 ingredients. Cut in shortening till mixture resembles fine crumbs. Spoon into canister.
Seal; store at room temperature up to 6 weeks or freeze for longer storage.
Cherry-Almond Drops (Makes 2 dozen): Combine 2 cups cookie mix, 1 egg, and ½ tsp almond extract. Add ½ cup chopped almonds and ¼ cup finely chopped maraschino cherries.
Drop from teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° for 8–10 minutes or just till edges are lightly browned. Cool on rack.
Festive Cutouts (Makes 3 dozen): Combine 2 cups cookie mix, 1 egg, and ½ tsp vanilla. Roll dough to ¼-inch thickness. Cut with 2½-inch cookie cutters.
Transfer to ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° about 8 minutes or till light brown. Cool on wire rack. Decorate with icing if desired.

recipes.title: Magic Cookie Bars
ingredients: 1 (14 oz) can Eagle Brand Sweetened Condensed Milk
steps: Preheat oven to 350° (325° for glass dish). In 13x9-inch baking pan, melt butter. Sprinkle crumbs over butter; pour sweetened condensed milk evenly over crumbs.
Top evenly with remaining ingredients; press down gently.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool before cutting.

recipes.title: Molasses Butterball Cookies
steps: In mixer bowl beat butter or margarine on medium speed for 30 seconds. Add molasses and beat till fluffy.
Add flour to butter mixture; beat at low speed till well blended. Stir in nuts. Using about 1 Tbsp dough for each, shape dough into 1-inch balls.
Place on ungreased baking sheet. Bake in a 325° oven 20 minutes. Remove to wire rack to cool. When cookies are cool, gently roll them in powdered sugar to coat.

recipes.title: Nana's Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
In a large mixing bowl, beat butter, granulated sugar, brown sugar, and vanilla until creamy.
In a small bowl, combine flour, baking soda, and salt.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Beat in flour mixture gradually. Stir in morsels (and nuts if desired).
Drop by rounded tablespoon onto an ungreased baking sheet.
Bake 8 minutes (2 minutes longer if you prefer crispier).
Cool 2 minutes on baking sheet; remove to wire racks to cool completely.

recipes.title: No-Bake Cookies
steps: Bring sugar, milk, cocoa, and margarine to a boil in a saucepan over medium-high heat, stirring constantly. When mixture reaches boil, continue stirring for one minute.
Remove from heat.
Add oats, peanut butter, and vanilla. Combine well. Form into balls and drop onto wax paper. Let cool. Makes 3–4 dozen.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Sugar Cookies
steps: In large bowl combine all ingredients. With mixer at medium speed beat until well mixed, scraping sides of bowl. Mixture will be crumbly.
Shape dough into ball and wrap with waxed paper; refrigerate 2 to 3 hours until easy to handle.
When ready to bake, preheat oven to 400° and lightly grease cookie sheets. On lightly floured surface, roll half of dough at a time, keeping rest refrigerated.
For crisp cookies roll dough paper-thin. For softer cookies roll out dough ⅛ to ¼-inch thick. Cut into shapes with floured cookie cutters.
Place ½-inch apart on cookie sheets. Bake 8 minutes or until very light brown. Remove to racks; cool immediately.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cut-Out Cookies
ingredients: ½ cup (1 stick) butter or margarine
⅔ cup packed light brown sugar
steps: Combine butter and peanut butter chips in saucepan; cook over low heat, stirring constantly until melted. Pour into large bowl, add brown sugar, egg, and vanilla.
Beat well. Stir in flour and baking soda. Refrigerate 15–20 min.
Heat oven to 350°F. Roll a small portion at a time on lightly floured surface to ¼" thick. Cut into desired shapes; place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 7–8 min.
Cool 1 min, remove and put on wire rack. Garnish with candy bits or frost.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Squares
steps: Mix peanut butter, honey, powdered milk, and vanilla until well blended. Pat into pan of desired thickness — either 8x8 in or 8x13 in.
Top with melted chocolate. Drizzle with glaze if desired. Cut into squares.

recipes.title: Puddin' Head Gingerbread Men
ingredients: ½ cup butter or margarine, softened
1 (3¾ or 4 oz) package regular butterscotch pudding mix
steps: Cream butter or margarine, brown sugar, and pudding mix. Add egg; beat well. Combine flour, baking soda, ginger, and cinnamon. Stir into creamed mixture; chill.
Roll part of chilled dough out on floured surface to ⅛-inch thickness. Cut with 4-inch gingerbread-man cutter. Place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake in 350° oven for 6 to 8 minutes. Remove from cookie sheet. Cool.
Mix powdered sugar, lemonade concentrate, and enough water to make spreading consistency. Frost gingerbread men or use pastry tube to pipe on frosting decorations.
Decorate with candies if desired.

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies
steps: Mix together. Roll out and cut.
Bake at 400° for 8 min.

recipes.title: Tri-Level Brownies
ingredients: ¼ cup butter or margarine, melted
1 oz unsweetened chocolate, melted and cooled
steps: For bottom layer, stir together first 4 ingredients and ¼ tsp salt. Stir in melted butter. Pat in 11x7½x1½-inch baking pan. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
For middle layer, combine granulated sugar, ¼ cup butter, and chocolate; add egg. Beat well.
Stir together ⅔ cup flour, baking powder, and ¼ tsp salt; add to chocolate mixture alternately with a mixture of the milk and vanilla, mixing after each addition.
Fold in nuts. Spread batter over baked layer. Continue baking at 350° for 25 minutes. Cool. Frost with Fudge Frosting. Cut into bars.
Fudge Frosting: In small saucepan melt chocolate and butter over low heat; stir constantly. Remove from heat; stir in powdered sugar and vanilla.
Blend in hot water (about 2 Tbsp) to make almost pourable consistency.

recipes.title: Famous Fudge
steps: Line 8-inch square baking pan with foil. In a medium heavy-duty saucepan, combine sugar, evaporated milk, butter, and salt.
Bring to a full rolling boil over medium-high heat, stirring constantly. Boil 4–5 minutes, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat. Stir in marshmallows, morsels, nuts, and vanilla. Stir vigorously until marshmallows are melted. Spread into prepared pan. Refrigerate until firm.
Lift foil from pan and cut into pieces.

recipes.title: Chocolate Toffee Layered Dessert
ingredients: 2 packages (4-serving size) JELL-O Chocolate Flavor Instant Pudding & Pie Filling
1 tub (8 oz) COOL WHIP Non-Dairy Whipped Topping, thawed
1 package (12 oz) Entenmann's Marble Pound Loaf, cut into ½-inch cubes
4 packages (1.4 oz each) chocolate-covered English toffee bars, chopped
steps: Pour milk into large bowl. Add pudding mixes. Beat with wire whisk 2 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes. Gently stir in 2 cups of the whipped topping.
Arrange ½ of the cake cubes in 3½-quart serving bowl. Drizzle with ½ of the chocolate syrup. Layer with ½ of the chopped candy bars and ½ of the pudding mixture.
Repeat layers ending with pudding mixture.

recipes.title: Cobbler
steps: Place berries on bottom of a pan. Mix in Jello and sugar. In a separate bowl, mix cake mix, margarine, and water. Spread evenly over berries.
Bake at 350° for about 20+ min til golden brown.

recipes.title: Creamy Apple Squares
ingredients: 1 package Pillsbury Plus Yellow Cake Mix
½ cup soft margarine or butter
¼ cup firmly packed brown sugar
steps: Preheat oven to 350°. Combine cake mix and margarine; mix until crumbly.
Reserve ⅔ cup for topping; add brown sugar and cinnamon to reserved topping mix, mix well, set aside. Press remaining mixture onto bottom of ungreased 13x9-inch pan.
Arrange apple slices over base. Blend sour cream and egg; spread evenly over apples. Sprinkle reserved topping mixture over all.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 min or until topping is golden brown and bubbly. Serve warm. Refrigerate leftovers. Makes 12 to 15 squares.
High Altitude: Bake at 375°

recipes.title: Creamy Banana Pudding
ingredients: 1 (14 oz) can Eagle Brand Sweetened Condensed Milk (NOT evaporated milk)
1 (4-serving size) package instant vanilla flavor pudding mix
3 medium bananas, sliced and dipped in lemon juice
steps: In large bowl, combine sweetened condensed milk and water. Add pudding mix; beat well. Chill 5 minutes. Fold in whipped cream.
Spoon 1 cup pudding mixture into a 2½-quart glass serving bowl. Top with one-third each of the wafers, bananas, and pudding. Repeat layering twice, ending with pudding.
Chill. Garnish as desired. Refrigerate leftovers.

recipes.title: Creamy Butter Frosting
steps: Cream butter in mixing bowl. Add vanilla extract, salt, sugar, and cream. Beat until smooth and of spreading consistency. If necessary, thin with additional cream.

recipes.title: Emily's Two-Layer Dessert
steps: Mix as crust in bottom of 9x13 pan. Bake at 350° for 15 min. Cool.
Mix and fold together. Spread over cooled 1st layer.
Cook flour and milk, stirring constantly, until thick. Cool completely.
Beat flour mixture with butter, sugar, and vanilla until spreading consistency — should look like whipped cream. Spread as top layer.
Refrigerate 2 hrs. Serve on taller plate, topping with remaining Cool Whip. Keep refrigerated.

recipes.title: Lemon Cheesecake Mousse
ingredients: 1 package graham crackers, crushed, plus more for garnish
1 cup whipped topping, plus more for garnish
steps: Divide crushed graham crackers between 4 dessert cups. In a large bowl using a hand mixer, whip cream cheese until light and fluffy.
Add powdered sugar, lemon juice, and salt and beat until combined. Fold in 1 cup whipped topping.
Pipe cream cheese mixture into cups and place in refrigerator until thickened, 1 hour up to overnight.
When ready to serve, top with remaining whipped topping and garnish with crushed graham crackers and lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Lemon Rice Pudding
ingredients: Lemon slices and fresh mint for garnish
steps: In a 2 qt dish, combine rice and sugar. Spread in an even layer; set aside. In small bowl, beat eggs, lemon extract, and lemon peel. Set aside.
In 2 cup glass measure, microwave milk on 100% power 1½ min. Gradually add milk to egg mixture, stir constantly. Pour milk/egg mixture over rice mixture in dish.
Microwave 18–21 min or until knife comes out clean. Spoon into 4 dessert dishes. Dust with nutmeg.

recipes.title: Luscious Layered Dessert
ingredients: 2 packages (4-serving size) JELL-O Vanilla Flavor Instant Pudding & Pie Filling
1 tub (8 oz) COOL WHIP Non-Dairy Whipped Topping, thawed
1 package (12 oz) Entenmann's All Butter Pound Loaf, cut into ½-inch cubes
steps: Pour milk into large bowl. Add pudding mixes. Beat with wire whisk 2 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes. Gently stir in 2 cups of the whipped topping.
Arrange ½ of the cake cubes in a 3½-quart serving bowl. Drizzle with ½ of the orange juice. Spread ½ of the pudding mixture over cake cubes. Top with strawberries.
Layer with remaining cake cubes, orange juice, and pudding mixture.
Refrigerate 1 hour or until ready to serve. Garnish with remaining whipped topping. Store leftover dessert in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Majestic Plum Pudding
ingredients: ½ cup chopped beef suet (3 oz)
1 cup finely chopped pared apple (1 large)
¼ cup mixed candied fruits and peels
steps: Soak the bread in milk; beat smooth. Stir in eggs, brown sugar, and suet. Stir together flour, baking soda, spices, and salt. Add fruits and nuts; mix well.
Stir in bread mixture. Oil and lightly flour a 1-quart mold. Press pudding into mold. Cover with foil; tie with string.
Place on rack in deep kettle; add boiling water 1 inch deep. Cover and steam 2 hours or till done. Serve warm with Foamy Sauce or Hard Sauce.
Foamy Sauce: Beat 2 egg whites to stiff peaks; gradually add 1 cup sifted powdered sugar. Beat 2 egg yolks and ¼ tsp vanilla till thick; fold into egg white.
Whip ½ cup whipping cream to soft peaks; fold into egg mixture.
Hard Sauce: Thoroughly cream ½ cup butter or margarine with 2 cups sifted powdered sugar. Add 1 tsp vanilla and 1 beaten egg yolk; mix well.
Fold in 1 stiffly beaten egg white. Chill. Pipe in rosettes around pudding using pastry bag if desired.

recipes.title: Man in a Hurry Cobbler
steps: Bake at 300° till done, light brown and bubbly.

recipes.title: Pear Crisp
ingredients: Pears, sliced — enough to fill a pie pan
steps: Mix ingredients — either melted butter or make a crumbly mixture. Slice pears — enough to fill a pie pan. Top with crumble mixture.

recipes.title: Powdered Sugar Pastry / Icing
steps: Mix in slow speed, then mix in fast speed. Always sift your powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Rainbow in a Cloud
ingredients: 1 pkg (3 oz) Jello Gelatin, any flavor
1⅓ cups Cool Whip Non-Dairy Whipped Topping, thawed
steps: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add cold water and pour into 8-inch square pan. Chill until firm, at least 3 hours.
Cut into cubes using sharp knife that has been dipped in hot water. Quickly dip pan in warm water. Remove cubes with spatula.
Spoon about ⅓ cup of the whipped topping into each of 4 dessert glasses. Using back of spoon, make depression in center and spread topping up sides of glasses.
Spoon gelatin cubes into glasses. Chill.

recipes.title: Rice Pudding
steps: Combine ingredients in baking pan. Cover and bake at 350° for 3 hrs or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Glogg Nog
ingredients: Ice Ring, ground nutmeg, stick cinnamon (all optional)
steps: Beat eggs on low speed of electric mixer till blended. Add sugar and spices. Beat at medium speed till sugar is dissolved. On low speed beat in softened ice cream.
Add the juices. Cover and chill. To serve, pour the ice cream mixture into a large punch bowl. Slowly pour in ginger ale, stirring with an up-and-down motion.
Add Ice Ring to punch bowl if desired. For each serving, sprinkle nutmeg atop and add a stick cinnamon stirrer if desired.
Ice Ring: Arrange orange slices in bottom of a small ring mold. Fill with cold water. Freeze till firm. Unmold onto plate; slip ring gently into punch bowl.

recipes.title: Kiwi Cooler
ingredients: 3 very ripe kiwis, peeled and sieved
steps: Combine wine, kiwi puree, sugar, and lime juice. Chill well or serve over ice cubes.

recipes.title: Lemonade
ingredients: ⅔ cup sugar (add more if needed)
steps: Mix together in a large pitcher. Pour over ice in glasses.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Yogurt Drink
ingredients: 1 small container low fat honey yogurt
2 or 3 cups fresh or thawed berries
steps: Blend together and serve.

recipes.title: Mango Cooler
steps: Combine mango puree, ice cream, tequila, and sugar in blender and blend well. Add ice cubes and blend until thick and frothy. Serve at once.

recipes.title: Orange Cooler
steps: Combine orange juice, wine, and sugar. Blend well. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice cubes and divide orange mixture among them. Fill glasses to top with ginger ale.

recipes.title: Orange Melon Wine Cooler
steps: Combine wine, melon puree, sugar, and lime juice and blend well. Chill thoroughly or serve over ice cubes.

recipes.title: Pineapple-Lychee and Rum Cooler
ingredients: 1 (20 oz) can seeded lychees in syrup
steps: Puree pineapple and lychees with syrup in blender. Add sugar and rum. Blend well. Blend ½ pineapple mix with 1 cup ice till frothy.
Repeat with other half of pineapple mix and ice cubes. Serve at once.

recipes.title: Strawberry Cooler
ingredients: 2 cups Muscat Alexandria or other sweet white wine
steps: Combine wine and strawberries in blender and puree. Strain. Add sugar and lime juice to wine mixture. Add ice cubes and blend till thick and frothy.

recipes.title: Cough Remedy
steps: Boil 20 min. Strain and drink.

recipes.title: Fruit Flavored Vinegar
steps: Heat sugar and vinegar. Pour over fruit in jar. Let set 5 days. Strain. Store.
